packageRules.description: A runner image sets the oldest glibc the Linux builds run on, so moving to a newer one is a decision about who can run Paperback (#1252), not a routine bump.
Gradle, the Gradle wrapper, the Android Gradle plugin, Kotlin and every library in the version catalog move together, majors included, so a Kotlin or AGP bump arrives with whatever it needs.
Everything the workflows pin (actions, the Rust toolchain, downloaded tools) in one PR, majors included, since the PR's own CI exercises all of it.

windows-core is only here for #[implement] in the UI Automation tests, which has to use the same windows-core the windows crate does. windows is still on 0.62, so raise this ceiling together with windows.
rodio-wsola, which time-stretches audiobook speed changes, is built against rodio 0.22 (axel10/rodio-wsola). Lift this together with a rodio-wsola release for 0.23.

hayro's PDF interpreter is built on skrifa 0.46, and the XPS parser shares that copy. A newer skrifa here alone adds another copy of skrifa and read-fonts to the binary, so lift this together with hayro.

customManagers.description: Cobalt is installed from a release tarball, so no manager sees it natively.
